name: Gossner Foods Cheese Factory Aged Baby Swiss & Cheddar Curds/Slices
brandOrRestaurant: Gossner Foods Cheese Factory Store (Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Gossner's world-famous Cache Valley Aged Swiss and Aged Sharp Cheddar have virtually 0g remaining lactose because the whey is drained and bacterial cultures consume all milk sugar during aging.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up sliced or cubed Gossner Baby Swiss or Aged Cheddar from the Logan factory store to pair with saltine/sourdough crackers for road trips up to Bear Lake.
watchOuts: Stick to aged block cheeses (Swiss, Cheddar, Muenster) rather than fresh unaged squeaky curds or flavored jalapeno cheeses; Gossner shelf-stable UHT milk still contains lactose unless labeled lactose-free
